summary: Repair Docker E2E tool and Rust dependency contract

delivery.outcome: Both Docker E2E profiles provide the tools and dependency-resolution behavior required by their existing test commands
nonGoals: No application or test behavior change
No dependency manifest or public interface change

architecture.decision: Keep Docker E2E self-contained by installing its invoked build tool and resolving the intentionally unlocked Rust library inside the disposable full image
architecture.rollback: Restore the prior E2E package list and locked Cargo fetch if a tracked Rust lockfile is adopted in a separately governed change

validation.evidence: Complete core E2E passes including workflow tests that spawn make
Full image resolves and tests the Rust library without requiring an absent committed lockfile
All required host and Docker gates pass
The implementation diff contains only Dockerfile.e2e plus ticket evidence
